description: This file defines the interface and implementation of a WorkerPool system within the Thunder::Core namespace. It includes classes for managing worker threads, scheduling, job submission, rescheduling, revoking, and monitoring dispatched jobs. The file also contains nested classes for timers, schedulers, and optional warning reporting features.

classes.name: IWorkerPool
classes.description: Interface for a worker thread pool, providing methods for submitting, scheduling, rescheduling, revoking jobs, and obtaining snapshots of the pool state.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Concrete implementation of a worker thread pool with scheduling, revoking, and monitoring capabilities, including internal classes for timers and job scheduling.

classes.name: WorkerPool::Timer
classes.description: Represents a scheduled timer associated with a job in the worker pool, capable of submitting jobs to the pool.

classes.name: WorkerPool::Scheduler
classes.description: Handles scheduling of jobs within the worker pool, interfacing with the timer system.

classes.name: WorkerPool::DispatchedJobMonitor
classes.description: Optional class for monitoring dispatched jobs, reporting warnings if jobs run too long.

methods.name: JobType::Submit
methods.description: Submits the job to the worker pool for execution.

methods.name: JobType::Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules the job to run at a specified time.

methods.name: JobType::Revoke
methods.description: Revokes the job, preventing it from executing if it hasn't already.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Submit
methods.description: Submits a job to the worker pool.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Schedule
methods.description: Schedules a job to run at a specific time.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules an existing job to a new time.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a scheduled or running job.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Join
methods.description: Waits for all jobs to complete and joins the worker threads.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID for a given worker thread index.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Snapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current worker pool status.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Run
methods.description: Starts the worker pool's thread processing.

methods.name: WorkerPool::Stop
methods.description: Stops the worker pool and all worker threads.
